ablation.multiplicity: one Holm family over all 30 tests (5 variants x 3 masks x 2 metrics)
ablation.test: two-sided paired-seed one-sample t test of variant-minus-A0 differences

baron_lodo.interpretation: low-resolution donor evidence; effect sizes remain primary
baron_lodo.interval: 95% Student-t interval across four donor effects
baron_lodo.test: exact two-sided sign-flip test over all 2^4 donor sign assignments

count_thinning.deployment_metrics: retain comparator thresholded recovery, gene_spearman and fill descriptively
count_thinning.inference: report paired mean differences and 95% t intervals; do not attach population-significance p-values because thinning replicates are technical corruption realizations, not independent biological replicates
count_thinning.model_seed_handling: average the three SC2 model seeds within each thinning replicate
count_thinning.reason_for_alignment: Comparator recovery_index is thresholded deployment recovery and is not the same estimand as SC2 masked-value recovery.
count_thinning.sc2_metric: SC2 recovery_index from expected_repair on all lost-positive entries
count_thinning.scvi_seed_handling: already averaged within thinning replicate in comparator replicate-level artifact
count_thinning.structural_metric_policy: Do not perform direct SC2-versus-comparator gene-Spearman significance tests. Stored comparator gene_spearman refers to thresholded deployed reconstruction, whereas SC2 gene_spearman is a candidate-value masked metric.
count_thinning.variance_decomposition: SC2 crossed 3 model seeds x 5 thinning replicates, separately for each dataset, q and metric; method-of-moments two-way random-effects decomposition with negative components truncated at zero

foundation_models.scfoundation: descriptive only; direct decoder result with pretraining-overlap limitation
foundation_models.scgpt: excluded from direct reconstruction according to frozen compatibility audit
